reproduction.interpretation: test suite expanded after handoff; use frozen-code replay count as executable oracle and preserve handoff count only as chronology

required_oracle_families.law: missing observability is UNKNOWN, never healthy
constant/stuck signal is distinguishable from healthy varying signal
declared expected state and observed activity are separate; declared-dead-but-writing is anomalous
context/system budget changes require end-to-end delivery tests, not constant inspection alone
countercontrols: history reaches model under sufficient budget
split budgets preserve history when within limits

required_oracle_families.law: coupling, decoupling and insufficient-evidence are three distinct outcomes
every critical guardian must be demonstrated on an injected known defect and a healthy countercontrol before being trusted

h1_requirement: Port these semantics into deterministic Reference Harness fixtures independent of historical German module names.
h2_requirement: ClayCode Harness must produce equivalent typed health/unknown/coupling outcomes under the same injected-defect traces.
h3_requirement: One-module architecture must preserve logical monitoring independence/fail-visible observability even when physical process boundaries are dissolved.
